body:
I've been doing percocets mixed with sleeping pills and alcohol regularly for 5 years now. I used to also do coke occasionally but have given it up...I was relating the coke to sex and it was making me do freaky things I didn't necessarily feel good about the next day. Anyway, the percocets have been great and today a neigbor gave me suboxone, telling me it's actually oxycontin. I looked it up online and found out it was actually suboxone and it was used as a way to withdraw from opiates like oxycontin.
I decided to give it a try...first, as I also do before I take oxycodone, I took four 25 mg of diphenhydramine (over the counter sleep aids), waited 10 minutes and took 4 mg of the suboxone (I cut my 8 mg in half with a knife...it's a very soft pill and can crush easily
). I put the pill under my tongue and let it dissolve. It dissolves very quickly, within a minute or two. It was orange flavored and tastes very bitter. It took about 45 minutes before it kicked in and it was real nice...the initial effects don't feel as euphoric as percs do but it does actually seem to build up as time goes on, as opposed to percs whose effects decline over the hours. I listened to music and chatted online with buddies feeling pretty damn great for the next two hours...then I took some pseudoephedrine, crushed it and swallowed. Then I had something to eat cause I hadn't eaten all day...still, I wasn't terribly hungry and I didn't want to dampen the effects of the suboxone by eating too much. I then took an additional 2 mg of the suboxone...now it's 6 hours later and I'm tired and energetic at the same time. I would love to have some rum alcohol (which I usually do with percs after an hour or so of the initial dose) but it's too early in the morning. All the liquor stores are closed...I have maybe 2 mg left and have read other experiences here that tell me the effects last up to 10 or 20 hours so I'll save the 2 mg for later today, perhaps mixing it with some alcohol. But right now, I'm gonna try and watch a movie and sleep (it's 4 a.m. Already...I took the initial dose at about 7:15 p.m. And I'm still feeling damn good!)
Overall, it's a damn good drug. It gives me a real sense of happiness and well-being within 30 mins. To an hour of taking it and after about 2 hours, I start to get bursts of euphoria...listen to some music or do something else I enjoy to add even more to my pleasure. I also got a very pleasant erection in the first hour of taking suboxone but it faded. It felt intense though. I tried to watch a little online porn to see if I could function but just as happens to me when I'm on opiates, I can't get an erection on suboxone either.
